title: Find the Closest Palindrome
goal: Find the nearest different decimal palindrome, choosing the smaller number on a tie.
strategy: Only mirrors of the current leading half and its immediate neighbors can be closest within this digit length. The all-nines and one-zero-one boundaries cover changes in digit count. Compare candidates with exact integers.

edgeCases: A power of ten ties with the shorter all-nines boundary
An existing palindrome must choose a different value
The smallest positive input can choose zero
